The '''Royal City''' was the capital city of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Simocadia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was [[Battle of Simocadia|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but was saved when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces repelled the invaders.<ref name="TCOD" />
